purpose: Spell out a numeral as an English ordinal word (18 -> eighteenth, 786 -> seven hundred and eighty-sixth) with arbitrary precision.

internalCode.role: Entire generator source: $output(n) entry point; chunk(), inEnglish(), appendScale() helpers; init() bootstrap (vendored big.js + digit/scale word tables on window).
Generator HTML body: heading, usage docs, live demo input (#userval) rendering [$output(userval.value)], inline <style>.

externalCode.note: main.pjs contains no {import:...} statements, so this generator has zero Perchance dependency generators/plugins to bundle. (It is itself published as an importable plugin.)

thirdPartyAssets.name: big.js
thirdPartyAssets.role: Annotated upstream source of the arbitrary-precision decimal library.

vendoredThirdParty.name: big.js
vendoredThirdParty.note: Minified big.js v4.0.2 is embedded verbatim as a single line inside init(), defining the global Big. It matches third-party/big.js-4.0.2/big.min.js exactly once the upstream file's header comment and trailing //# sourceMappingURL comment are ignored (both are comment-only).

projectResources.note: No images, audio, models, shaders, animations, JSON data, prefabs or templates exist in or are referenced by this project. All styling is inline CSS in index.html; the only decorative graphic is the Unicode die-face character U+2684 followed by U+FE0E (text presentation selector), written directly in index.html.
